summary: Reports on the IAB workshop Show me the numbers: Workshop on Analyzing IETF Data (AID), held online from 29 November to 2 December 2021 and hosted by the IN-SIGHT.it project at the University of Amsterdam. It had two discussion parts with a hackathon between them, and summarizes the discussions. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some researchers met online to talk about studying the IETF's own records, like emails and documents, as data. This is the meeting notes.
